name: generate_pdf
description: Render plain text (with an optional title) into a paginated PDF file on disk and return its path.

text.description: Body text. Newlines are preserved and long lines wrap automatically.

title.description: Optional bold heading on page 1, also set as the PDF document title.

output_path.description: Where to write the PDF. Defaults to document.pdf. Parent folders are created if missing.

font_size.description: Body font size in points, from 6 to 72. Defaults to 11.
